question:
In recent years, many small local shops have closed because customers travel to large shopping centers or malls to do their shopping.
Is this a positive or a negative development?
essay:
As time goes by, individuals tend to purchase their required stuff from shopping malls rather than local stores. This trend could be resulted to closure of many small stores. While this transition could be considered as a positive development not only for customers but also for the owners of large shopping malls, the owners of local stores would go bankrupt and lose their small businesses.

On the one hand, shopping malls located at the heart of cities with various options which facilitate people to travel one location. Moreover, shopping centers or malls will provide a wide range of options for people which are more affordable compared to the local stores. Various options for purchasing enables individuals to make an informed choice when they are trying to buy groceries or clothes. For instance, Walmart and Super Store are two prominent grocery stores in North America which are extremely attractive to customers due to various and more affordable options.

On the other hand, People could support the store which are in close proximity to their homes due to their sense of nostalgia. Furthermore, the local stores run by some individuals and they tend to be supported by people who live close by. However, the owners of these stores find a fierce competition in the market with shopping centers. Because most shopping centers are better-off, and they can offer a wide range of inexpensive products compared to the local ones.

To sum up, having large shopping malls in different cities could be considered as a positive development due to offering various stuff. Personally, I believe that purchasing from small local stores enables individuals to reminisce their past times as they were buying different stuff from them before the advent of shopping malls
